app_name: THE WORLD INSIDE: A little universe called Shruti
archetype: Organic & Earthy (Deep forest-green, antique gold, warm ivory, parchment)
key_features: Cinematic landing page with 'Enter the Universe' transition
Onboarding 'Welcome, Traveller!' panel with Guided Journey vs Explore Independently
Interactive 3D / Simulated Worlds (The First Hello Valley, The Castle Gallery, The Memory Garden, The Open Door)
Illustrated World Atlas (M key) with destinations, markers, and instant travel
'Meet Shruti' author biography and profile panels
Castle gallery with 5 project exhibits and 'View Project' modal/links
Living Archives library with 6 interactive books (page turns + 2D immersive reader)
Memory Garden poetry nook with contemplative verses
Persistent bottom narration, music player (Spotify embed simulation + volume controls), and captions bar
The Open Door contact form with validation and real submit feedback
Mobile touch controls, joystick, look drag, and responsive 2D fallbacks

accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_navigation: WASD / Arrow keys + Mouse look in 3D exploration, M key for Atlas, Escape to close modals

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all .js files in src/ implement the immersive aesthetic specified in design_guidelines.json. Use Tailwind CSS with custom classes matching forest green & antique gold palette. Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
